name: Creality Print
author: Shenzhen Creality 3D Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: A self-developed Fused deposition modeling slicing software produced by Creality.
description: Creality Print is a self-developed Fused deposition modeling slicing software produced by Creality. It’s a practical and easy-to-use tool that can help you remote control and monitor your 3D printer and help print directly from your computer.

versions.release_notes:
1. Improved how the SPARK i8 calculates the combined purge volume for scheduled pre-purging and color changes. Purge volume now adjusts based on how long the filament has been idle, reducing unnecessary purging and filament waste from the wipe tower.

2. Rounded the outer corners of the wipe tower to reduce frequent acceleration and deceleration, keeping extrusion pressure more stable during printing.

3. Updated the Online Parameters page to show only parameter packages for printers you’ve added.

4. Fixed an issue where travel moves after a filament change skipped Z-hop, allowing residual filament to leave color streaks on the model surface.

5. Improved object splitting so that suspended parts can retain their original Z positions.

6. Fixed an issue where the time-lapse toggle on the Send page could get out of sync with the printer’s settings.

7. Fixed an issue where the action buttons next to a custom process preset disappeared after loading a model.

##https://wiki.creality.com/en/software/6-0/release-notes-7-3-3

1. Added a pre-flush volume setting after filament change, printing thick lines on the wipe tower to address filament degradation on the i8; set it to 0 to disable pre-flushing.
2. Added speed control for unsupported solid infill and sloped-surface infill, detecting unsupported paths and lowering their print speed to reduce failure risk.
3. Added a minimum print thickness for color-mixing sublayers to reduce overly thin sublayers and improve stability in color-mixing and gradient printing.
4. Fixed an issue where updated online parameters did not take effect.
5. Added a temperature setting for the low-temperature heat-enhancing build plate.
##https://wiki.creality.com/en/software/6-0/release-notes-7-3-2

1. Added proactive assistance in the AI Edition for explaining non-default settings, recommending support settings, and troubleshooting slicing error codes.

2. Added No Wipe Tower Mode for SPARK i8, prioritizing purging along infill and inner-wall toolpaths to reduce color-change waste.

3. Fixed WAN print-start error XD0114 and incorrect color-change coordinates for CFS-C.

4. Re-enabled automatic mapping for K3 and added the option to enable timelapse from the Send page.

5. Fixed model-specific slicing errors and conflicts between arc fitting and speed smoothing, and improved slicing performance for models with many holes using the Hilbert Curve top surface pattern.

6. Fixed brief incorrect colors in Preview and display issues after slicing models that use color-mixing filaments.

7. Fixed paint-on supports not taking effect in certain model regions.

8. Improved sign-in after initial installation and fixed incorrect navigation to User Filaments when editing system filament presets.

9. Improved button labels in the floating-object dialog during G-code export and the estimated completion time display on the device details page.

10. Restored STL/3MF thumbnail previews and fixed the selection marquee remaining visible in the Measure tool.

##https://wiki.creality.com/en/software/6-0/release-notes-7-3-1

1. Full-Color Printing Enhancements: Added color prediction and automatic color mixing based on filament spectral data for more accurate color reproduction.

2. One-Click Color Separation for OBJ: Automatically detects colors in colored OBJ models and maps them to available filaments for a simpler color-printing workflow.

3. Gradient Color Printing: Create color gradients based on print height or selected regions for models such as skies, flames, and artistic designs.

4. Reduced Purge Waste: Optimized Purge to Object Skeleton to reuse part of the purge material as internal infill, reducing material waste where model structure allows.

5. K3 Multi-Nozzle Printing: Added support for different nozzle diameters, including 0.2/0.4/0.6/0.8 mm combinations, balancing print quality and efficiency within the same job.

6. New Adaptive TPMS Infill: Automatically adjusts infill density based on the model structure, supporting dense-outside/sparse-inside, uniform, and sparse-outside/dense-inside configurations.

7. New ZAA Anti-Aliasing: Optimizes top-surface toolpaths on curved, domed, and sloped structures to reduce stair-stepping and improve surface quality.

8. Slicing Performance Improvements: Optimized large 3MF loading, auto-orientation, and slicing workflows, with approximately 50% faster opening for large full-plate 3MF projects.

9. Multi-Nozzle & AI Enhancements: Added nozzle preheating and structure-based filament assignment, while upgrading AI Assistant and AI parameter recommendations.

10. More UX & Stability Improvements: Added Corner Rib for wipe towers and preservation of color/settings after model cutting, along with multiple fixes for slicing, printing, and cross-platform stability.

## https://wiki.creality.com/en/software/6-0/release-notes-7-3-0
Fixed the issue of local network video playback failure on K2, K2Pro, and K2Plus

1. Added support for Vietnamese, Indonesian, and Thai, with further improvements to Japanese translations.

2. Enabled the AI Assistant to answer questions using the current printer, loaded filament, software version, and other runtime context.

3. Added AI Parameter Recommendation support for 17 additional print settings covering supports, infill, wall generation, and more.

4. Added multi-printer print dispatch support for SPARKX i7.

5. Fixed an issue where Fuzzy Skin Point Distance and Fuzzy Skin Thickness settings were not displayed.

6. Fixed Linux issues related to crashes on exit and preset editing.

7. Fixed an issue where the application continued occupying memory after being closed.

8. Fixed crashes when deleting certain models from 3MF projects or arranging multiple imported STL files.

9. Improved re-slicing performance and fixed slicing crashes related to Paint-on Supports and Tree Supports.

10. Fixed issues involving the Prepare page, WAN camera live view, and AI command execution.

##https://wiki.creality.com/en/software/6-0/release-notes-7-2-1

1. Added AI Version (Beta) with an AI-guided printing workflow for a more intuitive user experience.

2. AI now assists with model import, model validation, automatic repair, and intelligent filament mapping.

3. Added AI-powered print risk analysis, pre-print inspection, parameter recommendations, and an AI Knowledge Assistant.

4. Added Mixed Filaments to create new colors by stacking different filament layers.

5. Added support for importing color OBJ files with color clustering and automatic filament mapping.
6. Optimize the estimated printing time for single-colour models,, reducing estimation error to within 5%.

7. Upgraded the support generation algorithm with the new Validate and Repair Supports feature for improved print reliability.

8. Added Purge to Object Skeleton (Experimental) to intelligently reduce purge waste in multi-color printing.

9. Model Repair is now available on macOS and Linux for a more consistent cross-platform experience.

10. Fixed multiple issues related to stability, AI features, slicing algorithms, and device compatibility.

##https://wiki.creality.com/en/software/6-0/release-notes-7-2-0

1. Hot updates are now supported on the Windows version, with no need to re-download or reinstall the full package.

2. The Send page and Device page now support displaying remaining CFS RFID filament (percentage / length). When filament is insufficient, the system can automatically detect and continue printing with filament of the same type and color.

3. The model Cut tool now supports quick right-click assignment to the opposite side.

4. The device list now remembers the user’s preferred Card View or List View layout.

5. Fixed an issue where QR code login was unavailable on some Mac devices.

6. Fixed an issue where purge volume information could not be generated when using PLA as the support interface material for PETG prints.

7. Fixed an issue where slicing progress could take excessively long at 70%–80% for some models.

8. Fixed an issue where the wall order parameter (Inner / Outer / Inner) did not take effect.

9. Fixed an issue where the camera zoom button was missing on some device detail pages in the Mac version.

10. Fixed issues related to camera buttons, translations, and abnormal parameter behavior on certain pages.

##https://wiki.creality.com/en/software/6-0/release-notes-7-1-1

1. Improved under-extrusion after overhangs for better surface quality

2. Optimized color change sequence, reducing purge by ~10%

3. Added Support Interface Ironing for improved bottom surfaces

4. Introduced Fuzzy Skin painting for localized texture control

5. Added custom ear-shaped brim for precise adhesion

6. Introduced wall-infill interlocking for stronger parts

7. Integrated MakeNow for a seamless workflow

8. Added material usage breakdown in G-code preview

9. Reduced rendering memory usage by ~10%

10. Fixed multiple stability and functional issues

##https://wiki.creality.com/en/software/6-0/release-notes-7-1-0

V7.0.1.4212 Software Update Notes:

1. Added support for connecting printers via Fluidd, improving remote device access and management.

2. New “Back Alignment” seam placement option, providing better control of visible seam positioning.

3. Fixed an illegal access error when selecting sequential (by-object) printing parameters.

4. Fixed Google account login failures.

5. Optimized travel path handling when internal bridge flow ratio is set to 0.

6. Fixed embossed text display issues and model shifting outside the build plate when undoing actions.

7. Fixed macOS issues including preset import failures, language reset after restart, and UI scaling incompatibilities.

8. Fixed unknown error prompts after installation and missing login prompts in Creality Cloud grouping when not signed in.

9. Fixed slicing anomalies including tree support not generating under percentage-based default line width mode and seam toggle issues in preview.

10. Improved device detail page UI compatibility, filament deletion logic, slicing dialog interactions, and built-in model mesh resolution.

V7.0.0.4127 Software Update Notes:

1. Comprehensive print algorithm upgrades significantly improve surface quality and vibration artifacts.

2. Introduce AI intelligent analysis to automatically check if the intelligent recognition model needs support.

3. Added multiple engineering-grade sparse infill patterns balancing strength, speed, and stability.

4. Major Prime Tower (wipe tower) enhancements improve multi-material print reliability.

5. Upgraded device management and WAN printing, including remote camera preview support.

6. K2 Plus–specific optimizations greatly improve print time and material usage estimation accuracy.

7. Deeply integrated Creality Cloud ecosystem with online models, tutorials, and store access.

8. Introduced LOD rendering to G-code preview for smoother interaction with complex models.

9. Enhanced third-party 3MF import and automatic migration of 6.x user presets.

10. Fixed bugs to significantly improve stability, compatibility, and localization quality.

V6.3.1.3548 Software Update Notes:

1. Support for CFS-C.

2. Firmware interface upgrades for K2 series printer, synchronized optimization of the device details page in slicing software.

3. One-click parameter setup support for PETG and PLA as support materials when selected as mutual support.

4. Fixed the issue where the angle would automatically change after flattening a model by face.

5. Optimized the failure prompt when uploading print files, with a new link to the wiki troubleshooting document.

7. Optimized UI for custom material creation, top navigation bar, dark mode, material mapping, login expiration, etc.

8. Fixed the issue where cloned windows could not be dragged.

9. Fixed the issue where selecting hybrid tree supports and checking the "only generate on build plate" option did not work.

V6.3.0.3420 Software Update Notes:

2. Added three TPMS infill types to support gradient density, enhancing model stability and material efficiency.

3. Improved height-based speed and acceleration settings interface.

4. Hidden or disabled high-risk/system-managed parameters for safer operation.

5. Added dual hotkey schemes for customizable user workflow.

6. Optimized rendering performance on the Prepare and Preview pages, significantly improving smoothness and visual clarity when working with large or complex scenes.

7. Optimized material waste reduction and improved print time and material usage estimation accuracy.

8. Resolved slicing crashes, preview errors, text rendering issues, and large file handling problems.

9. Fixed device related issues, including Sermoon D3 Pro preset and CFS information display.

10. Corrected multiple translation errors and improved font/UI display for clearer, smoother experience.

V6.2.2.3203 Software Update Notes:

1. Optimized the UI of process parameter display in the right panel — more parameter settings can now be shown on the same screen.

2. Fixed an error when running the Linux Flatpak version. #430

3. Fixed an issue where the process would remain running after closing the software on Linux. #443

4. Fixed an issue where usernames containing special characters could not log into Creality Cloud accounts. Thanks to @Aeath's Rock for the suggestion.

5. Fixed the error boost::filesystem::status: file or directory is corrupted and unreadable. Thanks to @emoji-道顺 for the suggestion.

6. Fixed an issue where enabling overhang optimization caused the path preview to show only support structures without the model.

7. Fixed low-accuracy temperature calibration models that caused uneven surfaces after slicing.

8. Fixed an issue where some areas could not be painted unless rotated multiple times. Thanks to @稷 for the suggestion.

9. Fixed an issue where the object selection count box text was overlapping. Thanks to @maynar598 for the suggestion.

10. Optimized K2 Plus preset parameters with 0.4mm and 0.6mm nozzles.

V6.2.1.3044 Software Update Notes:

1. Optimized the prompt message when clicking Auto Mapping without a connected printer.

2. Replaced the strong popup reminder when saving files locally with non-intrusive notification in the bottom-left corner.

3. Updated parameter presets for K2 and K2 Pro printers.

4. Fixed the lag issue when clicking the gear icons for Add Printer & Add Filament. Thanks to @夜梦无疆 for the suggestion.

5. Fixed the issue where ASA-CF filament could not be mapped in the CFS. Thanks to @bmarshall9686 for the suggestion.

6. Fixed the issue where Creality Cloud binds devices showed “downloading G-code” on the sending page without any timeout message.

7. Fixed the issue where selecting Dovetail in cutting mode made the model turn transparent. Thanks to @甘露 for the suggestion.

8. Fixed the issue where importing an STL file into an already open project changed the original project file name.

Feature
1. Improved slicing speed and smoother operation for a faster, more seamless experience.
2. Enhanced slow down for overhangs, significantly improving print quality for 20° overhangs.
3. Optimized top surface pathing, the top layer is now printed with a single continuous stroke that covers the largest possible flat area without 4. Pauses or visible seams, significantly improving top surface print quality.
4. Make Now modeling platform launched on homepage with AI modeling.
5. Added support for Sonic pad devices, currently compatible with Ender-3 S1 and Ender-5 S1.
6. A new user guide and WiFi icon for quickly connecting to a physical printer have been added to simplify the initial printer setup process.
7. Added multi-device sending—send print jobs to multiple devices of the same model at once.
8. New features for PETG/ABS: Overhang Optimization and Smart cooling zones(beta).
9. Added offline device diagnostics—quickly identify and fix issues when sending fails.
10. Improved preset sync process with login expiration reminders and optimized workflow.
Fixed
1. Fixed issue where imported 3mf files incorrectly showed default settings for process or material.
2. Fixed error caused by incomplete uninstallation: "System cannot find the specified file."
3. Fixed crashes during slicing or sudden exit at certain slicing progress percentages.
4. Fixed issue on Mac where left-click couldn't select multiple models at once.
5. Fixed Mac issue where preview didn’t play after slicing.

New Features
1.  Added support for Creality WiFi Box-related features and printers connected via WiFi Box.
2.  Improved file saving efficiency when using "Save Project As".
3.  Optimized the automatic model layout function.
4.  Improved the Copy & Paste (Ctrl+C and Ctrl+V) experience — pasted models will no longer overlap.
5.  Enhanced the Clone (Ctrl+K) operation with a preview effect when cloning models.
6.  Optimized model placement upon import — models are now automatically arranged (this behavior can be disabled in Preferences).
7.  Added a new "Layout Selected" feature to the Auto Layout function — only the selected models will be arranged within the build plate.
8.  Improved behavior during single-plate layout — when models do not fit within the plate, they will no longer "disappear" but instead be placed above Plate 1.
9.  Enhanced the Fill Build Plate feature — added a secondary menu allowing adjustments such as model spacing.
10. Introduced a Grid Layout option within the Fill Build Plate feature — models are forcibly arranged in a tidy checkerboard pattern, with a visual preview.
11. Enhanced the file sending page with additional information, including real-time transfer speed display.
Bug fixes
1.  Fixed an issue where the wipe tower was incorrectly displayed in single-color mode and mismatched in the object list and build plate. Thanks to @三月的狮子 for the suggestion.
2.  Fixed a boundary overflow issue with the wipe tower on Creality Hi model. Thanks to @Tanarnat Thai and Dr. Subashi Samarasinghe for the suggestion.
3.  Fixed shadow artifacts in the G-code preview page after applying Z-axis compensation to side-curved models. Thanks to @张勇 for the suggestion.
4.  Fixed an issue where both “Default” and “default” groups appeared simultaneously in the device list.
5.  Fixed a bug where logging out could occur automatically after restarting the software on macOS. Thanks to @梓申 for the suggestion.
6.  Fixed an issue where a recolored single-color model appeared with two colors when sending to the printer.
7.  Fixed an issue where Fluuid devices with the default name "other" could not be renamed. Thanks to @LookAtTheShinyShiny for the suggestion.
8.  Fixed a bug where STL files dragged into the software did not display model names.
9.  Fixed an issue where models in some 3MF files overlapped after auto layout.
10. Fixed a bug preventing PLY files from being opened via drag-and-drop or double-click.
11. Fixed several UI issues on macOS. Thanks to @tovi for the suggestion.
12. Fixed slicing failures occurring with some files.
13. Thanks for the translation update #369 #330

- 2.Optimized calculation accuracy for Creality HI time estimation.
- 3.Improved slicing efficiency when enabling support.
- 4.Added Ctrl/Shift multi-select in object management tree.
- 5.Smoother multi-device switching in details page.

Fixed
Hardware and Calibration Issues
- Incorrect default values for [PA Calibration]
- The target chamber temperature always shows 0 and needs to be fixed.
Machine Printing and Parameter Issues
- For the 3V3PLUS machine with IP 172.23.215.254, when sliced by a K2 machine and sent to the machine for printing via the local network, the machine always starts printing; also, the parameter update fails when clicking "Update Parameters" in the parameter set.
Gcode-related Issues
- Network send gcode causing the printer to report error 2060 and abnormal image previews.
UI Display and Software Adaptation Issues
- [Mac] Software adaptation issue on high - resolution laptops, as shown in the figure.
- When printing too many models on one plate, the object exclusion window on the device details page displays abnormally and cannot show all the content.

Features
- Adapt for Mac devices (x86 Inter chip).
- Flushing multiplier, upper limit, and minimum flushing volume adjustment.
- Optimization of calibration-related functions.
- The effects of overhang optimization (Beta) and Variable layer height can be applied simultaneously to a model.
Bugs
- Fixed an issue where special character paths caused printing anomalies.
- Fixed an issue with abnormal connection to the camera.
- Fixed the severe shrinkage layer issue caused by abnormal fan speed during color change in multi-color printing.
- Fixed the surface printing issue caused by extra inner wall paths on the top surfaces.
- Fix printing anomalies sent by the LAN printing (such as 2060 errors, coordinate errors, etc.)
